observations: Photo 0 shows two red game boxes on a patterned surface.
No console (PS4) body, ports, controllers/pads, or accessories are visible.
No readable model/serial, storage size, or brand/model markings for the console are visible.

claims.claim: Customized PS4 big, with 2 pads, 7 games and complete accessories
claims.evidence: Only game boxes are visible in photo 0; no PS4 console, controllers/pads, or full accessory set shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No photos of seals, internal inspection, or repair indicators.
No temperature/usage test footage or logs shown.
No close-ups of ports or demonstration of HDMI/USB/audio/network working.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No controllers/pads or receipt shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: You may not be buying a PS4 at all (photos only show game boxes; console not shown).
risks.proof: Send a clear photo of the actual PS4 console (front + back) showing model/label and ports, plus a photo of both controllers/pads.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: not verifiable/assume console condition unknown and not confirmed as the claimed item.

risks.risk: Controllers/pads may be missing, not original, or not working.
risks.proof: Video clip showing both pads charging/connecting and working in-game (buttons responsive).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume 2 pads not guaranteed working/original.

risks.risk: Games count/ownership may be different from the claim (only 2 boxes visible).
risks.proof: Photo showing all 7 games together (or a screenshot list) and close-up of each disc/cover.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume fewer games included.

risks.risk: Port failures (HDMI/USB/audio/network) or system faults may exist even if it powers on.
risks.proof: Short test video: HDMI to TV display, USB device detection, audio output, and network connection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume ports may not all work.

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues may appear under load.
risks.proof: Video showing gameplay for 20–30 minutes with no shutdown + (if possible) a temperature reading app.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume overheating risk.

risks.risk: “Never opened or repaired” could be false; fan/thermal paste condition unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of warranty seal status (if any) and/or a receipt/invoice for service; otherwise a teardown photo is needed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume it may have been repaired/opened.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual PS4 console (front and back) with the model label/serial visible.
Photo of both controllers/pads (front + back) showing they are included.
Photo showing all 7 games together (or a screenshot list) and close-ups of each.
Video test: power on → HDMI display → controller pairing → open a game → confirm USB/audio/network.
Video showing at least 20–30 minutes gameplay without shutdown/overheating.
response.reason: The only photo shows game boxes; the PS4 console, controllers, ports, and receipt are not shown, so a worst-case price cannot be safely matched to the claimed item.
